question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a white present, Bob has a green present, Claire has a silver present, Dave has a orange present, Eve has a brown present, Fred has a teal present, and Gertrude has a pink present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Eve and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Eve swap their gifts. Finally, Fred and Dave swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) white present
(B) green present
(C) silver present
(D) orange present
(E) brown present
(F) teal present
(G) pink present
solution:
Each row lists gift colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: white, green, silver, orange, brown, teal, pink
1. Eve ↔ Claire: white, green, brown, orange, silver, teal, pink
2. Fred ↔ Claire: white, green, teal, orange, silver, brown, pink
3. Bob ↔ Fred: white, brown, teal, orange, silver, green, pink
4. Eve ↔ Fred: white, brown, teal, orange, green, silver, pink
5. Alice ↔ Fred: silver, brown, teal, orange, green, white, pink
6. Claire ↔ Eve: silver, brown, green, orange, teal, white, pink
7. Fred ↔ Dave: silver, brown, green, white, teal, orange, pink
Claire has the green present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
